name: faq-update
description: A FAQ update skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. Before sending the update request, it automatically reads the current FAQ and writes a local JSON backup file containing the pre-update backup bundle.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code of the FAQ being edited. First call `languages-get`, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

faq.description: Required. FAQ fields to update. `faq_id` is mandatory. Every other field is optional and should be omitted unless the user explicitly wants to change it.

faq_id.description: Required. Existing FAQ ID to update. First call `faq-read`, then copy one exact `faq_id`.

faqgroup_id.description: Optional. New FAQ group ID. Omit this field to keep the current group unchanged.

cover_image.description: Optional. New cover image payload, up to 500 kB. Omit this field if the cover image should stay unchanged.

question.description: Optional. New FAQ question, up to 100 characters.

tags.description: Optional. New FAQ tags, up to 6 unique items with 3 to 50 characters each.

summary.description: Optional. New FAQ summary as plain text, up to 500 characters.

answer.description:
Optional. New HTML answer fragment. Do not include any `

` tag, and prefer `

` to `

`. `` may use a normal URL or `data:image/...;base64,...`. At most 50 `` tags are allowed. Each single `` image must be 500 kB or smaller. The 100,000-character limit is checked after removing `` tags, and the server uploads supported base64 images and replaces them with URL addresses. Before generating this field, call `rule-get` with the exact selected `language` and the exact scene value `faq.answer`.

seo.description: Optional. New FAQ detail page SEO fields.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact FAQ edit request after seeing the final language, FAQ ID, and payload. That approval must also cover the automatic pre-update backup read and local backup file write before the update request is sent.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language, target FAQ ID, and exact FAQ payload to be changed.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language, target FAQ ID, and exact payload shown to the user before execution.

faq.faq_id.description: Select one existing FAQ ID from `faq-read` under the same language.

faq.faqgroup_id.description: Use this only when moving the FAQ to another FAQ group.
